lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white line segments visible across the torso. Spacing is relatively uniform along the mid-lateral axis, with an average distance of approximately 40-50 pixels between primary line centers.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the 4th line from the anterior, splitting into a Y-shape at the upper mid-torso. A second bifurcation/merger is visible on the 9th line in the upper posterior region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line segments 3, 7, and 10 show significant discontinuities, appearing as dashed or abbreviated segments that terminate before reaching the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lateral surface of the posterior haunch and upper hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two circular spots on the upper hind limb align horizontally, forming a semi-connected geometric line segment.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a white chevron-shaped marking on the nasal bridge, two white spots on the cheek/mandible area, and a large white transverse patch on the throat.
